subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that short takeoff (STO) is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.1.1 Short takeoff (STO). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities for all STOs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of all STOs to evaluate air vehicle capabilities and control margins during STOs, to include: a. Land-based STO. b. Land-based formation STOs (< maximum performance for lead air vehicle). c. Land-based ski-jump STO (flight test purposes). d. Shipboard flat deck STO. e. Shipboard ski-jump STO. f. Auto-STO land-based. g. Auto-STO shipboard. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Short Takeoff (STO) paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Land-based STO. b. Land-based formation STOs (< maximum performance for lead air vehicle). c. Land-based ski-jump STO (flight test purposes). d. Shipboard flat deck STO. e. Shipboard ski-jump STO. f. Auto-STO land-based. g. Auto-STO shipboard. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Short Takeoff (STO) paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Land-based STO. b. Land-based formation STOs (< maximum performance for lead air vehicle). c. Land-based ski-jump STO (flight test purposes). d. Shipboard flat deck STO. e. Shipboard ski-jump STO. f. Auto-STO land-based. g. Auto-STO shipboard.
